negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 22231041 (Munster, JCO) found NO benefit of triptorelin for ovarian preservation, directly contradicting PROMISE-GIM6. This disagreement is the honest state of the evidence and must be shown, not resolved by picking a side.
PMID 19135657 and PMID 21693037 are trials where triptorelin was the comparator that did not win.
cautions: PROMISE-GIM6 (PMID 21771987) and its long-term report (PMID 26720025) are the SAME trial reported twice - do not count them as two independent trials.
Triptorelin Pamoate appeared as a separate candidate in this scan; it is the same compound in a different salt.
Same flare-effect and bone-density cautions as goserelin.
